text: 财政部、税务总局7月28日对外发布公告，明确将调整部分能源资源行业企业城镇土地使用税政策。 根据此次发布的公告，此前出台的煤炭、矿山、油气、建材、电力等行业企业的部分主要生产经营用地免征城镇土地使用税优惠政策将取消；同时，上述企业中具有公益性、安全保障性质以及重大基础设施用地的免税政策将予以保留。
text_en: The Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration issued a notice on July 28 clarifying adjustments to the urban land use tax policy for some enterprises in energy resources industries. According to the notice, preferential tax exemptions for urban land use tax on certain major production and operating lands of enterprises in coal, mining, oil and gas, building materials, and power industries will be abolished; tax exemptions for public welfare, safety, and major infrastructure lands of these enterprises will be retained.
